Calculate the classification threshold of each signature

Source: R/internalFunctions.R
calculateThreshold.Rd

This function calculates the classification threshold of each signature using the mixture model of normal distributions. The threshold corresponds to the 95th percentile of the sub-distribution with the lower mean value (the alternative distribution). A sample with a score above the threshold has a probability lower than 0.05 of being part of the alternative distribution.

Usage

calculateThreshold(geneLists, modelMix)

Arguments

geneLists

a list containing signature gene lists.

modelMix

a list containing one entry for each gene signature present in the geneLists object. Each entry contains the mixtures of two normal distributions for the signature calculated with sampled values. The entry corresponds to the object returned by the `mixtools::normalmixEM` function.

Value

a list containing one entry for each gene signature present in the geneLists object. Each entry contains the classification threshold of the signature. When the mixture of normal distributions has not been calculated successfully, the NA value is returned.

Author

Astrid Deschênes

Examples


## Required library
library(mixtools)
#> mixtools package, version 2.0.0.1, Released 2022-12-04
#> This package is based upon work supported by the National Science Foundation under Grant No. SES-0518772 and the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative: Essential Open Source Software for Science (Grant No. 2020-255193).

## Two demo signatures
geneLists <- list("SignatureA"=c("EGFR", "CTTN", "ACTB"), 
    "SignatureB"=c("ACTR2", "AKT1"))

## Create a demo mixture model
set.seed(121)
modelExp <- normalmixEM(c(rnorm(50, mean=-0.4, sd=0.2), 
    rnorm(50, mean=0.4, sd=0.2)), k=2, verb=FALSE)
#> number of iterations= 24 
model <- list("SignatureA"=modelExp, "SignatureB"=modelExp)

## Calculate the classification threshold of each signature
splitTypeR:::calculateThreshold(geneLists=geneLists, modelMix=model)
#> $SignatureA
#> [1] -0.09313736
#> 
#> $SignatureB
#> [1] -0.09313736
#>
